title: The Great Haze: Start here
summary: Start here: what The Great Haze is, its status, and how these pages are organized.
bodyHtml:
Working title. A modern horror take on Oregon Trail: lead a wagon train 840 miles to the Blue Reach while a crimson fog, the Great Haze, closes in behind you. Resources are always tight, half of the people begging for help are lying, and you can never stop for free.

Repository: https://github.com/kvick-games/the-great-haze (local checkout D:\Dreamatron\Games\TheGreatHaze). Project authority: project.dtproject, project id the-great-haze. File paths on these pages are relative to the repo root.

Status

  • Playable in 3D in the browser; the simulation core is implemented and tested.
  • Not yet bound to Dream Engine: src/main.ts is still the placeholder and no Studio scenes exist. See Build, test and verify.
  • Several features are in progress. They are collected on In progress and marked there; nothing else on these pages is speculative.

Read in this order

  1. Brief and pillars: what was asked and the six pillars the rules enforce.
  2. Core loop and systems: how a run works, with a page per system.
  3. Content catalog: the 84 scenes, 8 enemies, roster and companions.
  4. Web client: the Three.js presentation layer.
  5. Story and video pipeline: story graph, character datoms and Hyperlab video.
  6. In progress: work underway right now.
  7. Build, test and verify and Glossary.

Source of truth

These pages summarize and link. The repo owns the detail:

  • docs/game-brief.md: the original request, untouched.
  • docs/design.md: premise, art direction, systems, tuning.
  • docs/video-pipeline.md: the story layer and video routes.
  • docs/handoff-video-experiment.md: the plan for dialogue, maps, companions and video.
  • AGENTS.md: rules for agents working in the repo.
